answer: Submitting an answer locks 57 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The gale escrow is released only against a whisper receipt, and the prism audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 108 aliases means carrying 50 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
